correctness.rationale: The equation is A²=0 and AB+BA=0, with the entry-equation scheme as base, not its reduced orbit closure. Rank r forces Jordan type (2^r,1^s), s=n−2r. With a decomposition into image, s-dimensional middle space, and complement to the kernel, A is the identity block from the last summand to the first. Writing those indices as I,H,J, the independent constraints on B are B_JI=B_JH=B_HI=0 and B_JJ+B_II=0. They give 2r²+2rs=2r(n−r) constraints even in characteristic two. The group centralizer is open in the linear commutant, of dimension 2r²+2rs+s², hence the orbit has dimension 2r(n−r) and is geometrically irreducible. The linear maps in B have constant rank on that orbit, giving a kernel vector bundle and an irreducible total space of dimension n². All closures are distinct (rank cannot increase on specialization); equal dimension precludes proper containment. Since they cover the geometric reduced support, they are exactly its components. Choosing image, containing kernel, and the quotient-to-image isomorphism gives the two Gaussian coefficients and GL_r; multiplying by the kernel size gives the exact summand including r=0. The independent replay directly tested pairs for (q,n)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3), with rank counts (16,12),(81,72),(512,672), and used elimination of the explicit anticommutator at (2,4), obtaining (65536,107520,53760). The replay is bounded and does not independently test the recorded extension-field cases; the proof covers them.

originality.rationale: The strongest distinct indexed power-zero theorem uses the same entry-equation scheme and supplies the rank of the defining differential and the exact labelled dual-number count for arbitrary exponent, characteristic and Jordan type. Its exponent-two specialization gives every frozen arithmetic summand and mechanically gives the full geometric conclusion: constant rank on each irreducible orbit, sum of base and fiber dimensions n², and distinct equal-dimensional closures. Several additional records explicitly reproduce or refine the arithmetic marginal; one reproduces the n=3 geometric example. These are existing equivalent or stronger mathematical coverage at review time, not evidence of who published or discovered the result first. The earlier reduced nilpotent-jet literature is not the reason for failure.
residual_risks: Priority, dependence between dated records, and other independent prior formulations are not determined. The exact existing coverage is established without resolving these questions.
